Themes

Dupli ships with six color themes. They style the prompt, status lines, streamed thinking output, and errors.

ThemeVibe
dupliThe default violet
nordCool blues and frost
draculaPurple and pink, loudly
solarizedClassic teal and ochre
everforestSoft greens
monoNo color beyond weight

Switching

Live, for the current session:

» /theme dracula

Or persist it in a config file:

{ "theme": "nord" }

Or one-off from the shell:

dupli --theme everforest

If a theme name isn’t recognized, Dupli lists the valid ones and falls back to the default.
